name: local-autocorrect
description: Silently fixes typos as you type. Runs entirely on your machine.

autocorrect.enabled.description: Automatically correct typos when a word is completed.

enumDescriptions: Only fix single-slip typos with a clear winner.
Also fix two-slip typos and closer calls. More fixes, more false corrections.
Also fix rare words when one plausible candidate is the clear winner. Most fixes; revert teaches it new words.

autocorrect.languages.description: Language IDs in which autocorrect is active.

autocorrect.customDictionary.description: Words that should never be corrected.

autocorrect.learnFromReverts.markdownDescription: When you revert a correction (undo or the hover's **Revert**), add the word you typed to `#autocorrect.customDictionary#` so it is never corrected again.

enumDescriptions: A soft tint flashes on the corrected word and fades, then a faint dotted underline stays.
autocorrect.correctionCue.markdownDescription: How corrected words are marked. Hover over an underlined word to see what you typed and revert it. Underlines are kept in memory only and disappear when the document is closed.

autocorrect.highlightCorrections.markdownDeprecationMessage: Replaced by `#autocorrect.correctionCue#`; this setting is ignored.

scripts.package: npm run build -w @autocorrect/core && node build.mjs && vsce package --no-dependencies
